query: Calculate the climatological mean Mixed Layer Depth (MLD) in the North Pacific Ocean during boreal winter (December-February) from 2000 to 2020, using a density threshold criterion of 0.03 kg/m³.
Compute the monthly Niño 3.4 index from January 1980 to December 2023 and identify El Niño events (index > 0.5°C for at least 5 consecutive months).
Calculate the mean nutricline depth for nitrate in the equatorial Pacific (5°S-5°N, 160°E-280°E) during 2015-2020 and compare it with phosphate nutricline depth in the same region and period.
